context: A police officer discusses a case
purpose: Teach: 過失/匹敵/八木/出血/究明/受診/遮断/一刻

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、運転者の過失、明らかになりました。
lines.en: The driver's negligence in this case has been confirmed.
lines.style: Even, measured tone. Professional formality without stiffness. Clear authority delivered with quiet composure. No warmth, no coldness—just factual precision.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 被害規模、過去の大事件に、匹敵しますね。
lines.en: The scale of the damage matches past major incidents, doesn't it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly tentative. Genuine intellectual curiosity mixed with awareness of the gravity. Leaning forward slightly in posture. Soft upward inflection on the particle, seeking confirmation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。八木さん、被害者のご家族の代表者です。
lines.en: Yes. Yagi-san is the family representative for the victim.
lines.style: Neutral, procedural delivery. Slight formality shift when naming the family representative. Respectful pause before the role. No elaboration—just the necessary information stated clearly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 現場、出血の跡、確認されたんですね。
lines.en: Blood traces at the scene have been confirmed, I understand.
lines.style: Careful, almost hesitant phrasing. Acknowledging the weight of what he's saying. Slower pace. A small breath before the key detail. Checking himself against the gravity of the evidence.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。事件の究明、警察、総力を挙げております。
lines.en: Yes. The police department is putting its full effort into investigating the case.
lines.style: Steady, resolute. Slight emphasis on 「総力」—conveying commitment without defensiveness. Professional reassurance. Even cadence, like a public statement made in private.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 目撃者、すぐ受診されて、無事だったそうですね。
lines.en: The witness was seen by a doctor right away and is safe, I've heard.
lines.style: Quiet relief underlying the statement. Genuinely searching for the silver lining in dark circumstances. Warm curiosity—wanting to confirm the one good outcome. Slight softening at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。現場周辺、交通遮断、迅速に、行いました。
lines.en: Traffic around the site was blocked off swiftly.
lines.style: Factual, procedural. Brief and assured. No elaboration—the action speaks for itself. Professional pride in competent execution, stated without arrogance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一刻も早く、事件の解明、進むといいですね。
lines.en: Hopefully the case can be resolved as quickly as possible.
lines.style: Quiet hopefulness tempered by realism. Slower pace. Leaning into the desire for resolution without naïveté. The closing statement of someone genuinely invested in the outcome. Slight trailing-off, like a wish placed gently.
